## What each kind of rejection asks for

- **INFO_NEEDED** — Reply in Resolution Center with: (1) a screen recording on a physical device running the latest iOS, from launch through sign-up, login, account deletion and paid features; (2)-(6) purpose, setup/credentials, external services, regional differences, regulation.
- **SPAM_4_3** — Do not resubmit. Reply answering nine questions: what it does, who for, market gap, beta testing, suite or standalone, could it be an in-app purchase elsewhere, shared code with your apps, shared code with third parties, made for a client.
